title: Verify and dogfood planning end to end
description: Run final black-box, integration, concurrency, compatibility, recovery, and cross-platform verification after every planning task and document is complete. Cover create/list/show/update/set-status/report; all statuses and revisable transitions; six-field mixed-case AND filtering; global IDs and branch scopes; cross-lifecycle dependencies and blocked readiness; live reusable assignments; execution stats/batch/graph/claims isolation; dry-run byte identity; dependency-closed and rejected promotions; atomic rollback/roll-forward at every journal boundary; canonical exports; malformed legacy/planning data; shared stores; and Unix/Windows paths. Use a disposable store to plan one project/version/milestone, research and plan its items, reject/reopen one item, preview the group, promote it, then claim it as todo. Run gofmt, go test ./..., go vet ./..., documentation and skill validators, git diff --check, repository verification, and Unix/Windows smoke/prerelease coverage. Record commands, evidence, platform skips, and residual risk in the completion comment.
